description: A repository search function builds a SQL string via template-literal interpolation of an external query parameter and executes it directly.

required_findings.exploit_preconditions: Any caller of searchRepositoriesByName with a value they control for fullNameQuery — e.g. `' OR '1'='1` or a UNION-based payload — no parameterization or escaping happens anywhere before the string reaches pool.query().

explanation: The textbook case §3.3 documents directly: a template literal interpolated into a raw SQL string, executed via a real driver's .query(sql) with no placeholder. High confidence is appropriate here — the sink (pool.query with a raw string) and the source (a function parameter with no validation) are both fully visible in a four-line function, no missing context anywhere.
